batch_prep.station: SATURDAY — DRY BRINE CHICKEN THIGHS (5 min)
tasks: 2.5 lbs bone-in skin-on chicken thighs — pat very dry; rub all over with: 1 tbsp kosher salt + 2 tsp smoked paprika + 1 tsp garlic powder + 2 tsp brown sugar + 1/2 tsp cayenne + 1/2 tsp black pepper; place on wire rack over sheet pan; refrigerate UNCOVERED overnight — this builds the bark for Sunday's smoke.

batch_prep.station: SUNDAY — FIRE SMOKER (start 10am — ~2 hrs, mostly hands-off)
tasks: Heat smoker to 275°F using apple or cherry wood chips; place dry-brined chicken thighs skin-side up on grate; smoke 1.75–2 hrs until internal temp hits 185°F; last 20 min brush with BBQ sauce every 10 min for sticky glaze; pull and rest 10 min tented; shred half the batch for Fri/Sat smoked chicken spinach wrap bowls (label WRAP BOWLS); keep remaining whole/chunked for Wed dinner street corn platter (label STREET CORN); refrigerate all in labeled airtight containers.

batch_prep.station: BREVILLE OVEN — BATCH CHICKEN THIGHS (prep 12 min | roast 32 min, runs while smoker is going)
tasks: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs — pat dry; season with: olive oil + lemon zest + garlic + dried oregano + salt + pepper (LEMON-HERB — for Mon/Tue lunches); roast at 400°F for 30–32 min; cool 10 min; slice thin; portion into 4 labeled containers: LEMON-HERB.

1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs — season with: sesame oil + soy sauce + ginger + garlic powder (SESAME-GINGER — for Wed/Thu Thai soba salad lunches); roast alongside at 400°F for 30–32 min; cool; slice thin; label SESAME-GINGER.

1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs — season with: 1 tbsp olive oil + 2 chipotle peppers in adobo (minced) + 1 tsp cumin + 1 tsp smoked paprika + salt; roast at 400°F for 32 min; shred and toss with extra chipotle sauce; label CHIPOTLE (Sunday lunch).
Batch 1 — 3 cups dry jasmine rice → ~7.5 cups cooked; used for teriyaki bowls (Mon), chipotle burrito bowls (Sun), Thai beef stir-fry (Thu); portion into labeled containers.
Batch 2 — 2 cups dry quinoa → ~4 cups cooked; used for lemon-herb med bowls (Mon/Tue) and bruschetta chicken bowls (Sun); portion into containers.
Batch 3 — Soba noodles: cook 12 oz dry soba (boil 4 min, rinse cold immediately!); toss with 1 tsp sesame oil; portion for Wed/Thu Thai soba salad lunches.

TERIYAKI GLAZE (Mon dinner): 3 tbsp soy sauce + 2 tbsp honey + 1 tbsp rice vinegar + 1 tsp fresh ginger + 1 clove garlic minced + 1 tsp sesame oil; whisk in small saucepan over medium; simmer 3–4 min until slightly thickened; jar and fridge.
LEMON-HERB DRESSING (Mon/Tue lunches): 3 tbsp olive oil + 3 tbsp fresh lemon juice + 1 tsp Dijon + 1 clove garlic minced + 1/2 tsp dried oregano + salt + pepper; whisk; jar and fridge.

SESAME-LIME DRESSING (Wed/Thu soba salad): 3 tbsp sesame oil + 2 tbsp soy sauce + 2 tbsp lime juice + 1 tbsp rice vinegar + 1 tsp honey + 1/2 tsp grated ginger + 1 clove garlic; whisk; jar and fridge.
PICKLED CUCUMBERS (Mon teriyaki bowls): 2 Persian cucumbers sliced thin + 3 tbsp rice vinegar + 1 tsp honey + pinch salt; toss; cover; fridge overnight — ready by Monday.
2× Lemon-Herb Chicken Med Bowls per person — Mon/Tue lunches (keep dressing + feta separate; Cameron gets avocado fresh daily).
2× Thai Soba Salad per person — Wed/Thu lunches (keep dressing separate; lighter chili for Cameron; avocado fresh daily).
2× Smoked Chicken Spinach Wrap Bowl per person — Fri/Sat lunches (assemble from Wednesday smoker shreds; Cameron + avocado fresh).
1× Chipotle Chicken Burrito Bowl per person — Sun lunch (assemble from chipotle roast chicken batch).
NEVER put avocado in any Austin container — allergy. Label all containers: 'A' or 'C'.
No egg/toast prep needed — made fresh each morning (10 min).
Cameron avocados: buy 5–6 whole avocados, store at room temp until ripe, then refrigerate; slice fresh daily.

batch_prep.station: SUNDAY DINNER — Bruschetta Chicken Bowls (made fresh ~6pm, 45 min)
tasks: Roast 1.5 lbs chicken breasts + 2.5 lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes in Breville at 400°F (~22–25 min chicken, ~30 min potatoes); meanwhile dice Roma + cherry tomatoes with fresh basil + garlic + olive oil + balsamic for bruschetta topping; assemble bowls; top with shredded mozzarella + bruschetta + optional balsamic glaze drizzle.
Cameron: + 1/4 avocado and extra balsamic glaze. This is a fresh Sunday cook — don't batch-prep it.
